Why do you say "must"?
It's a crab, isn't it?
It is.
And crabs are good to eat.
What's so good about them?
You don't like crab?
Why? How can you eat those things? They've all purple and yellow striped, and they stink like cat pee...
But that's just my opinion, don't listen to me.
Let's see here. The guide says... no way. It says they're delicious.
Well, if you want to eat one, then you go right ahead. But count me out.
C'est noté. Ça doit être super bon à manger, non?
Comment ça, 'ça doit être'?
C'est un crabe, n'est-ce pas?
Et les crabes, c'est bon à manger.
Pourquoi ils sont si bons?
Tu n'aimes pas les crabes?
Pourquoi? Comment est-ce qu'on peut manger ces trucs? Tout violet avec des bandes jaunes, et en plus, ils puent la pisse de chat...
Oublie ce que j'ai dit, c'est mon opinion, c'est tout.
Voyons voir. D'après le guide... mais je rêve. Ils disent que c'est délicieux.
Eh bien, si tu veux en manger un, ne te gène pas. Mais ne compte pas sur moi.
By the way, does that mushroom recharge your batteries when you eat it?
I mean, it seems like if you ate a glowing mushroom, it might recharge your batteries or something.
Snake, your batteries are organic batteries. They produce electricity by utilizing the potential difference between cells.
Organic batteries are known for their highly efficient energy conversion,
but they still rely on chemical reactions between proteins and enzymes to...
So you're saying they'll get recharged?
Believe what you want.
Au fait, est-ce que ce champignon recharge tes batteries quand tu en manges?
Oui, à t'écouter, on dirait qu'en mangeant un champignon luminescent, on pourrait recharger ses batteries.
Snake, tes batteries sont des piles organiques. Elles produisent de l'électricité en utilisant la différence de potentiel entre les cellules.
Les piles organiques sont connues pour leur conversion énergétique très efficace,
mais elles dépendent toujours de réactions entre les protéines et les enzymes pour...
Alors elles vont se recharger?
Crois ce que tu veux.
Eat one and see? What do I look like, a lab rat?
Shhh!
What? What'd I say?
What if the rats hear you? You'll hurt their feelings.
En manger un pour voir? Tu me prends pour un rat de laboratoire!
Chuuut!
Quoi? Qu'est-ce que j'ai dit?
Et si les rats t'entendaient? Ça leur ferait peut-être du mal.
If it looks like a shiitake mushroom, then it must be edible, right?
Yep. I can't guarantee that it'll taste like a shiitake mushroom, though,
Si ça ressemble à un shiitake, ça doit être comestible, non?
Ouaip. Mais je ne te garantis pas que ça aura le même goût qu'un shiitake.
You made a hole in the wall? That's great. Now use it to escape before the guard sees it!
Tu as creusé un trou dans le mur? Génial. Emprunte-le pour t'échapper avant que le garde ne le remarque!
Snake, you've got an arrow stuck in you.
Snake, tu as été atteint par une flèche.
Ooh, you've got a terrible cold.
Ooh, tu as un mauvais rhume.
The poison dart frog is native to the tropical rain forests of Central and South America.
They normally grow between two and five centimeters in length,
but for some reason the ones in that area seem to be much bigger than that.
Poison dart frogs are known to carry a potent neurotoxin called pumiliotoxin.
Long ago, people used the poison to coat their arrows for hunting.
Watch out because if you eat one, you'll get food poisoning.
La grenouille dendrobate est originaire des forêts tropicales d'Amérique Centrale et d'Amérique du Sud.
Elles atteignent entre 2 et 5 cm à l'âge adulte,
mais je ne sais pas pourquoi, celles de cette zone semblent être bien plus grosses que cela.
Les grenouilles dendrobates produisent une neurotoxine très puissante, la pumiliotoxine.
Autrefois, les gens trempaient leurs flèches dans ce poison avant d'aller à la chasse.
Fais attention de ne pas en manger où tu auras une intoxication alimentaire.
OK, we'll talk about something you are interested in, then.
The taste!?
It says here... that coral snakes are pretty good, in a snaky kind of way.
A snaky kind of way, huh...
OK, alors je vais te parler de quelque chose qui t'intéresse.
Quel goût ils ont?!
D'après mon guide... le serpent corail est assez bon, pour ceux qui aiment manger des serpents.
Pour ceux qui aiment manger des serpents, mmm...
Got it. So...?
What -- How does it taste?
It seems you're the one whose diet consists of other snakes.
You're making me blush.
...The guide says they taste just fine.
Compris. Alors...?
Quoi - quel goût ça a?
Toi aussi, tu manges principalement d'autres serpents.
Tu me fais rougir.
... D'après ce guide, ils ont assez bon goût.
Snake, where are you going? You won't get to Groznyj Grad by heading that way.
You have to sneak into Groznyj Grad by going underground.
There should be a door opening to the underground entrance near the middle of the summit.
If you have the key EVA gave you, you should be able to open it.
Go back to the summit and head underground.
Snake, où est-ce que tu vas? Tu n'arriveras à Groznyj Grad en te dirigeant par là.
Tu dois t'infiltrer dans Groznyj Grad en passant par le sous-sol.
Il devrait y avoir une porte qui mène à l'entrée souterraine près du milieu du sommet.
Si tu as la clé qu'EVA t'a donnée, tu devrais pouvoir l'ouvrir.
Retourne au sommet et emprunte le passage souterrain.
As long as you put out the flames right away, you shouldn't get burned.
Si tu éteins immédiatement les flammes, tu ne devrais pas être brûlé.
Snake? You're already in the sewers....?
EVA? Yeah, I just got down here.
I'm coming to meet you now. The door at the north end is open, right?
Let me guess - there's a problem.
What is it this time?
The colonel found out you escaped.
He did, huh. Figured as much.
Yeah, and now all of Groznyj Grad is on red alert.
Just my luck. But once I'm out of the fortress...
You can't get out.
I can't?
When the fortress went on red alert, they sealed off the sewers.
I'm serious. And that means the escape route I laid out...
...is sealed off too.
Right. And they just sent a unit out looking for you.
Down here?
Uh huh. They'll be there any minute now. You've got to get out quick!
But isn't the exit sealed off?
You should be able to get out by heading straight north. Book it Snake! If they find you, you're dead!
Snake? Tu es déjà dans les égouts...?
EVA? Ouais, je viens d'y entrer.
Je viens à ta rencontre. La porte au nord est ouverte, c'est bien ça?
Attends... Je parie qu'il y a un problème.
C'est quoi, cette fois?
Le colonel sait que tu t'es échappé.
Ah bon. Ça ne m'étonne pas.
Et maintenant, tout Groznyj Grad est en alerte rouge.
C'est bien ma veine. Mais une fois sorti de la forteresse...
Tu ne peux pas sortir.
Lorsqu'ils ont mis la forteresse en alerte rouge, ils ont condamné les portes des égouts.
Dis-moi que tu plaisantes.
Malheureusement, non. Ce qui veut dire que l'issue de secours que j'avais prévue...
...est également condamnée.
Exact. Et ils viennent d'envoyer une unité à ta recherche.
Quoi, ici?
Ouaip. Ils vont arriver d'une minute à l'autre. Il faut que tu sortes, et vite!
Mais la sortie n'est pas condamnée?
Tu devrais pouvoir sortir en te dirigeant tout droit vers le nord. Dépêche-toi, Snake! S'ils te trouvent, tu es fichu!
You got some instant noodles, huh?
Instant noodles?
Uh huh. It was invented in Japan just recently. Add some hot water and it's ready to eat.
It's cheap and can be stored for a long time. And besides, it's delicious. It's like a miracle food.
Speaking of which...
Are you going to eat that?
I was planning on it, yeah.
...Oh, all right.
No, that's not what I meant.
Then what did you mean?
I was just going to say that if you weren't going to eat it, you should bring it back to me. I've always wanted to try some.
Tu as trouvé des nouilles instantanées, hein?
Des nouilles instantanées?
Mm mm. Les Japonais viennent de les inventer. Il suffit d'ajouter de l'eau chaude et c'est prêt.
Ce n'est pas cher et ça se conserve très longtemps. Et en plus, c'est délicieux. Bref, une nourriture miraculeuse.
En parlant de ça...
Tu vas les manger?
J'en avais bien l'intention, oui.
... Oh, tant pis.
Pourquoi, je ne devrais pas les manger?
Non, ce n'est pas ce que je voulais dire.
Alors, qu'est-ce que tu voulais dire?
Je voulais juste te dire que si tu ne les mangeais pas, tu pouvais les garder et me les rapporter. J'ai toujours voulu en goûter.
The light from the lamps will cause your Camo Index to drop way off.
In other words, you'll be much easier for the enemy to see if you stand next to a lamp.
En pleine lumière, ton indice de camouflage va atteindre presque zéro.
Donc les ennemis te remarqueront bien plus facilement si tu es debout près d'une lampe.
You were right.
About what?
I ate a Russian glowcap and it charged up my batteries.
I, uh... that's... that's great!
Tu avais raison.
A propos de quoi?
J'ai mangé une russule phosphorescente et ça a rechargé mes batteries.
Je, euh... c'est... génial!
That area is home to the Reticulated Python.
The Reticulated Python is said to be the longest snake in the world. The biggest ones can grow up to 10 meters in length.
Although they're not poisonous, they're still very dangerous, so be careful around them.
They have a highly ferocious temperament, and they can swallow whole even large animals like deer and pigs.
Their most distinguishing feature is the mesh pattern of their scales.
This pattern acts as a highly effective natural camouflage.
If you think there might be a Reticulated Python about, pay close attention to your surroundings.
Otherwise you could get bitten before you even know it's there.
It's a huge snake, but you should be able to capture it alive by using the tranquilizer gun.
I'll bet if you capture one and throw it at an enemy, it'll give him a good scare.
Right. But - how do they taste?
Do they taste good?
You're actually going to eat one?
Why else would I be asking?
Nothing. Let's see what the guide says... Ah, you're in luck. It says they taste pretty good.
Good. I can hardly wait.
Snake, that area is inhabited by the Giant Anaconda.
The Giant Anaconda is believed to be the largest snake in the world in terms of weight and diameter.
It's not poisonous, but its large size makes it extremely powerful.
They say it even eats crocodiles. Its only natural predator is man.
And snake.
...And snake.
Magpies are members of the crow family. They're distinguishable by their beautiful dark blue and white bodies and their long tails.
Their favorite food is insects, but they'll also eat small fish, acorns, and fruit. They're omnivores, which means...
They'll eat anything.
Right. Just like you, huh.
If you use the tranquilizer gun, you should be able to capture Magpies alive.
That area is home to the Sunda Whistling-Thrush.
The Sunda Whistling-Thrush is a bird native to Java and Sumatra.
It's distinguished by its large blue body and long beak. It really stands out in the forest.
If you're aiming to catch one alive, use the tranquilizer gun.
You should be able to find Russian Oyster Mushrooms in that area.
The Russian Oyster Mushroom is an edible variety that belongs to the Shimeji family.
It's known to be particularly rich in vitamin B1 and Niacin.
Apparently, it's usually found growing on tree stumps and hollow logs. So look there if you want to eat some.
You should be able to find Siberian Ink Cap mushrooms growing in that area.
The Siberian Ink Cap is a mushroom from the ink cap family.
Its life cycle is transitory. As soon as the spores mature, the cap starts to turn black, liquefy, and melt away.
And that's why they call it an ink cap?
That's right. It doesn't really turn to liquid, but you get the idea.
In its immature state - before it melts away - it's valued as a source of food.
Just be sure not to eat them while you're drinking alcohol.
Ink Caps contain coprin, which inhibits the function of aldehyde dehydrogenase.
This prevents the body from breaking down alcohol, causing a buildup of acetaldehyde.
... Meaning?
Meaning it will give you the hangover from hell.
Yablo... what now?
Yabloko Moloko. It's a Russian name that roughly translates as "milk apple."
It's a type of star apple. The juice is thick and sweet, like milk - hence the name.
And if you cut one in half lengthwise, you'll see a star-shaped ring radiating out from the center.
Hence the star apple?
Right. The star-shaped part has a gelatinous texture and is said to be especially tasty.
A fruit called the Russian False Mango grows in that area.
The Russian False Mango is a mango-like fruit found only in Tselinoyarsk.
The egg-shaped fruit is sweet and tangy with a pleasing aroma; just like a mango.
Also, the seeds can be used to make a medicine that aids in digestion.
It might come in handy if you ever have an upset stomach.
Snake, there should be Vine Melons growing in that area.
The Vine Melon is a kind of melon commonly found in Tselinoyarsk.
Like the name says, it's a melon that grows on a vine. The flesh is crisp and delicious.
The Vine Melon is full of potassium and carotene, so it's good for you as well.
Next time you see a vine, why not check to see if there's a melon growing on it?
When you get hurt, your body will heal itself naturally over time.
However, the speed at which your LIFE recovers depends on how much stamina you have at the time.
The more stamina you have, the faster you'll recover.
So if you want your wounds to heal quickly, you should eat something and replenish your stamina first.
Snake, do you know what epinephrine is?
What's with the questions?
Well, do you?
Also known as adrenaline?
I have.
Good for you.
Do you want to hear about it?
Oh, I think you should hear about it.
Here we go.
So...
Epinephrine is a type of hormone.
It's secreted from the adrenal glands in high-stress situations - like when you're exercising, or you're under pressure.
The epinephrine is released into the blood- stream and stimulates special receptor cells on various organs throughout the body.
This causes the heart to beat faster, the blood vessels to constrict, and the respiratory passages to expand.
It also raises blood pressure.
You ever notice how you're faster and stronger than normal when you're under stress?
That's because of epinephrine. And when you're bleeding, it...
Is there a point to all of this?
Of course. In the Alert Phase, your body secretes epinephrine, and so your stamina won't be depleted as fast.
...Uh huh.
There, good thing I told you, huh?
As always.
Are you a medic, or a doctor?
I'm a well-respected physician. Or I was, until I joined the CIA.
How was your reputation?
My what?
Your reputation.
Oh, that.
How was it?
Why? Don't you trust me?
Fine, then.
Mm hmm. ...So?
So what?
Your reputation - how was it?
My! You're relentless!
Hey, I'm a snake. So?
My reputation was spotless. I'm highly skilled, patient, and good-looking to boot.
Everybody wanted to see me. What else would you expect?
No, seriously.
Incidentally, her nickname back then was "Quack".
...Is that true?
Mm? Is what true?
About your nickname.
No! ...Well, maybe a few people did call me that...
So you were a quack?
No! ...Well, yes and no. I mean, in a sense I was, but then again I wasn't...
Snake, her skills as a doctor are beyond reproach. You have my word on that.
Yes! That's exactly what I was trying to say, Snake.
Then why did they call her "Quack"?
It's because she...
Never mind that! It doesn't matter.
We've got a job to do, and we have to stay focused. Besides, my past doesn't have anything to do with the mission and...
Because she never shuts up?
Yes, that's it.
No, that's not it! Snake, tell him that's not true!
Say something!
I'd better get back to the mission.
Yes, you do that.
Just a minute! Snake! Don't you hang up on me!
If you have any questions about stamina or healing, just ask me.
I'll tell you everything you need to know. It'll have to be over the radio, though.
So you won't be able to see me naked, then.
Yeah, I'm devastated. But I'll bet that 50 years from now, you'll be able to see who you're talking to on the radio.
I'll be retired from active duty by then.
I don't know. Somebody somewhere might just decide to give you a call.
Wouldn't surprise me. Let's both pray that never happens.
Snake, if you or one of your comrades is wounded in battle, what do you usually do?
I call for a medic.
What if there's no medic nearby?
I don't even want to think about that.
Think about it.
...That's my worst nightmare.
Any soldier can perform basic first aid, but it takes a specialist to perform the more complicated procedures.
I know a lot of guys who'd be still be alive today if they'd had access to a medic.
Me, too.
So I got to thinking - wouldn't it be great if we could parachute medics into the front lines, where they're needed most?
You bet... That's why you're called "Para-Medic"?
Yeah. With a unit like that, we could save a couple of lives, huh?
Not a couple. We could save many lives.
...Thanks. I think the army needs a unit like that. And if no one else will do it, I'm going to create one myself.
Sounds like a plan.
Will you help me?
Count on it.
Snake, unlike the Virtuous Mission, this is a night operation.
You'll be encountering nocturnal animals that you didn't encounter your last mission.
Some of them are venomous, like the king cobra, so be careful.
If you get bitten by a venomous animal, the poison will spread through your body and rapidly drain your LIFE gauge.
If that's the case, go into the "CURE" screen in Survival Viewer immediately and inject yourself with serum. Got it?
Treating serious wounds will require you to use additional medical items besides your knife and cigar.
That's why it's always a good idea to carry as many medical items with you as possible.
If you start to run out of medical items, find some more as soon as you can.
The enemy should be carrying medical supplies as well.
You can get them by holding up enemy soldiers and shaking down their bodies.
Hey, that's Kerotan!
Right there. See it?
Where?
Right in front of you.
...This frog doll?
That's Kerotan. Don't tell me you've never heard of him.
Is he famous or something?
Come on, everybody knows about Kerotan.
...Oh. OK. But what's this frog thing doing here?
Kerotan.
He's called Kerotan.
Right... So what's this Kerotan doing here...
He must be getting popular in the Soviet Union.
Here?
Not that you'd know anything about the magic of Kerotan.
On the other hand, you might be able to use Kerotan's power to help you in your mission.
What did you have in mind?
Kerotan cries when you shake him. If the enemy hears that, they might come to check it out.
Maybe you could use it as a diversion?
And I hear that if you find all of the Kerotans and shake them, something good will happen. Try it out.
You say there are attack dogs?
Those attack dogs are Great Danes.
The breed is originally from Germany. They've been used for hundreds of years as hunting dogs.
As you can see, they're very large. Strong, too.
They've got a calm yet courageous temperament. And on top of that, they're extremely intelligent.
In some cases, a trained Great Dane can be more dangerous than a human opponent. Watch out for them.
Interesting.
Forget it, Snake!!
Forget what?
You were thinking about how they taste, weren't you?
I wasn't thinking...
Don't lie to me. I could tell by the look on your face.
You can't see my face.
No, but I can imagine it!
Don't you dare think about trying to capture an attack dog.
You hear me!?
Those dogs may be highly trained, but you might still be able to distract them by throwing them something tasty to eat.
Give it a try!
Snake, your LIFE will naturally recover even if you're wounded.
But how fast it recovers depends on how much stamina you have. If your stamina is low, your LIFE will recover more slowly.
If you want your wounds to heal, you should eat something first and replenish your stamina.
You can make your LIFE recover faster by staying in a crouching or lying position.
If you get injured, find someplace where you're safe from enemy attacks and let your LIFE recover! OK?
As long as you use all those items, the cut should heal up completely. Hurry and get it fixed up!
Ocelot's pistol uses really powerful bullets. And he's a crack shot, too, so if he hits you you'll probably be severely wounded.
If you get seriously wounded, go into the Survival Viewer right away and treat it with "CURE". Got it?
It looks like there's a hornets' nest up there. If it falls down, you'll be attacked by the hornets inside.
What's wrong? Are you hurt!?
Then what?
These hornets won't go away.
The hornets?
Yeah. They've been flying around over my head in a figure-eight pattern and won't go away. Any idea why?
Well, hornets use the figure-eight dance to signal that they've found food...
Food?
Yeah. Like flowers or nectar...
What does it mean?
I don't know. But at least they're not attacking you, right? I think it's best to just leave them alone.
You've got bigger things to worry about - like Ocelot.
Good point.
You can beat him, Snake.
Who said I couldn't?
Snake, you won't be able to see a thing with a swarm of hornets covering your head.
The hornets can't follow you into the water. If you find your vision being blocked by a swarm of hornets, dive into the water!
You could also try driving them away with the smoke from your cigar.
Waving your torch around with the CQC button should also work.
You might be able to trap some of the hornets by throwing a hornets' nest at them.
If you succeed, it should reduce the number of hornets The Pain has at his disposal. It might even make the nest taste better.
Try it out!
Hornets are known to display extremely aggressive behavior in response to the color black.
So don't wear black clothing. Instead, try wearing white clothing. It should reduce the severity of the hornets' attacks.
Using insecticidal bug juice on yourself should make the hornets' attacks less severe. Try it out.
The Fear coats his poison bolts with venom from the Brazilian wandering spider.
The Brazilian wandering spider is said to have the deadliest venom of any spider in the world.
It's a potent neurotoxin, so if you get hit by one of The Fear's poison bolts,
go to "CURE" in the Survival Viewer and inject yourself with serum immediately before it kills you!
If you run out of stamina, you won't be able to resist the effects of The End's tranquilizer rounds, and you'll end up falling asleep.
Hunt for food on a regular basis to keep your stamina level up.
If you start to run out of food or ammunition, you should think about leaving the woods and coming back later.
In any case, always keep an eye on your stamina gauge. You'll thank me later.
It's started to rain, huh.
We know that Major Raikov is a glutton. Maybe you could use that to your advantage.
Why not give him something rotten to eat and then lay an ambush for him in the toilets?
The tunnel looks like it's getting pretty hot. That's what happens when you use such a powerful flamethrower in an enclosed space.
In that kind of heat, you'll lose stamina more quickly than normal.
Be sure to eat something to replenish your stamina before you get too exhausted to fight.
Snake, I... Ah!
H... hello there.
Para-Medic, it's me.
Snake? Oh, it's you. For a minute there, I thought you were someone else...
Why are you so nervous? You've seen this mask before, right?
Yeah, but it looks so cool...
Cool. You know? Kind of like a Venusian.
A Venusian...?
I mean, not the crab kind... the other kind.
Para-Medic, do you really think a guy you've never seen before would suddenly call you on this frequency?
I know, it sounds ridiculous. But still...
What if it was a being from another planet? You can't rule out that possibility.
You need to build up your stamina before trying to escape. Without your stamina, you won't have the strength to punch and kick.
Snake, do you have any clothes?
So you're still naked?
When you don't have any clothes on, your body loses heat quickly.
That makes you burn stamina a lot faster. Make sure you keep eating.
It doesn't need to be clothes. Anything you have that can cover you up should help you conserve stamina...
The enemy has sent out attack dogs after you. You won't stand a chance against them in your present state. Just keep running north!
Snake what if you put on that mask? You might just be able to shake Volgin up!
Shake him up? Why!?
Never mind. Just do it!
Snake, you're running out of time! The C3 is about to explode!! Hurry up and defeat Volgin!!
Snake, the enemy is hot in pursuit. If they catch up to you, you're dead! You've got to get away from them!!
While you're riding in the Sidecar, lying down won't cause your LIFE to recover gradually like usual.
If you need to restore LIFE, use the LIFE medicine!
Snake! The Shagohod!! There's no time left!! Blow up the bridge, quick!!
The Shagohod's weapons are deadly. You're likely to get seriously hurt if you get caught in its sights.
If you get injured, go into the Survival Viewer and take care of it immediately!
Snake, pay attention to EVA's LIFE gauge. Make sure you don't attack her by mistake!
Snake, you're almost to the lake. Hold on just a little longer!
You can treat EVA's wounds by selecting "EVA" from the "CURE" screen in the Survival Viewer.
If she gets injured, see to her right away. Got it?
You and EVA are both exhausted. You need to take it easy.
If you find a good place to hide, like tree hollows or bushes, lie low and let your LIFE recover. Got it?
Snake, don't forget about EVA's stamina. She'll collapse from exhaustion if she runs out.
If EVA's stamina starts to run low, go into the Survival Viewer and give her something to eat.
To give her some food to eat, select a food item from "FOOD" and press the Enter Button, then select "EVA".
But don't give her anything rotten or poisonous!
I see it's started to rain. You burn through stamina a lot faster when it's raining.
It'll also reduce your visual range and make it more difficult to sense where the enemy is. Be careful.
Snake, your escape is going to be a test of endurance.
If you find edible plants or animals, be sure to catch enough for EVA to eat, too.
Snake, EVA's all out of stamina! Quick, give her something to eat!
Snake, the lake is just up ahead! You can make it!!
The Boss is human just like you and me. If she gets distracted, she's sure to leave herself open to attack.
Try throwing a magazine or a captured animal and see what happens!
Snake, pick up the gun already! Trust your instincts!
Snake, king cobras are making their home in the area you're in now.
I see you've caught a king cobra.
The king cobra is the world's largest venomous snake.
Its large size means that it has a lot of venom to inject. One bite is supposedly enough to kill an elephant.
And it's extremely vicious as well, so watch out.
If you get bitten by a king cobra and injected with venom, your LIFE will start to decrease rapidly.
As soon as you're bitten, go into the Survival Viewer and use "CURE" to give yourself a serum injection.
The king cobra's diet consists mostly of other snakes. Be careful or you might end up as its next meal.
That area is inhabited by the Taiwanese cobra.
The Taiwanese cobra is native to Taiwan and southern China.
It's quite vicious, and carries a potent neurotoxin in its fangs. Be careful.
If it bites you, go into the Survival Viewer immediately and use the "CURE" option to inject yourself with serum.
Sounds interesting...
Don't ask me.
The guide doesn't say. If you absolutely have to know, then you'll just have to try it yourself and see.
But you were going to ask, weren't you? About the taste?
...Maybe.

While you're disguised as Raikov, you can go anywhere you want and no one will stop you.
So now might be a good time to go and collect some items.
For instance, I heard there's a rare goody on the east side of the second floor of the east wing.
Une fois déguisé en Raikov, tu pourras aller n'importe où, personne ne t'arrêtera.
C'est donc le moment idéal pour aller chercher quelques objets.
Par exemple, il paraît qu'il y a un truc assez rare dans la partie est du deuxième étage de l'aile est.
Snake, EVA said the sewers have been sealed off. If you go up the ladder, I'm afraid all you'd find is the enemy waiting for you.
Do as EVA says and run to the north! The enemy is bound to have sent a search party after you. Hurry!
Snake, d'après EVA, les égouts ont été condamnés. Si tu montes à cette échelle, j'ai bien peur que tu tomberas sur des ennemis en train de t'attendre.
Fais ce qu'EVA t'a dit et cours en direction du nord! L'ennemi a sûrement une patrouille à tes trousses. Dépêche-toi!
I see you've got yourself an M37.
Yeah. A 12 gauge shotgun.
It holds up to 4 shells. But, because it uses pump-action, you can only fire one shot at a time.
I know that much.
It's not exactly the best long-range sniping tool,
but it's got a wide distribution pattern, and a direct hit is enough to blow an enemy to bits.
It's about two pounds lighter than an ordinary shotgun. That should make it a bit easier to handle in the jungle.
Right. They don't call it the "featherlight" for nothing.
Not only that, but the barrel and the stock on this one's been sawn-off too.
Making it easier to carry around with you.
Yeah... But why did those guys have an American-made shotgun?
Good question. It might have something to do with studying Western weapons, but...
Tell me, have you ever heard about the SAS using shotguns in the jungles of Malaya?
In the jungle, enemy encounters can happen when you least expect it.
They found the shotgun to be extremely effective in these situations
because of its ability to deliver massive firepower in a short period of time.
Since then, the shotgun has become the weapon of choice for a lot of point men.
And now the Soviets have adopted the technique?
Could be.
Je vois que tu as dégoté un M37.
Ouais. Un fusil à pompe de calibre 12.
Il contient un maximum de 4 cartouches. Mais c'est un fusil à pompe, alors tu ne pourras tirer qu'un seul coup à la fois.
Ça, je le savais.
Ce n'est pas la meilleur arme pour des tirs à longue distance,
mais elle est très répandue et un seul coup suffit à réduire tes ennemis en miette.
Il pèse aussi environ 1kg de moins qu'un fusil à pompe classique. Ça devrait faciliter son maniement dans la jungle.
Oui. On ne le surnomme pas le "poids plume" pour rien.
Et en plus, sur celui-ci, le canon et la crosse ont été sciés.
Pour qu'il soit encore plus léger.
Oui... Mais pourquoi est-ce que ces types ont un fusil à pompe de fabrication américaine?
Bonne question. Peut-être qu'ils étudient les armes occidentales, mais...
Dis moi, tu savais que les SAS utilisaient des fusils à pompe dans la jungle malaisienne?
Dans la jungle, les rencontres ennemies arrivent au moment où on s'y attend le moins.
Ils se sont rendu compte qu'un fusil à pompe pouvait être très efficace dans ces moments-là,
en raison de sa puissance de tir sur une courte période de temps.
Depuis, le fusil à pompe est devenue l'arme de prédilection pour un grand nombre de tireurs d'élite.
Et maintenant, les Soviétiques ont adopté cette technique?
C'est possible.
If you create an electronic disturbance with a chaff grenade, the Shagohod won't even be able to launch its missiles.
So use your chaff grenades!
Si tu brouilles les signaux électroniques avec une grenade Chaff, le Shagohod ne pourra même pas lancer de missiles.
Alors utilise tes grenades Chaff!
Para-Medic!? Thank God. EVA's been seriously hurt!
So have you!
Luckily, I think her organs are all intact, but...
Calm down, Snake.
Calm down...?
You'll both be fine as long as you get the proper emergency treatment.
But you're the only one who can do this. Understand? So you've got to calm down.
Right. OK...
OK. Now, let's open up the Survival Viewer and treat the injury. Do you have supplies with you?
I'm running kind of short.
Then, by switching the Survival Viewer over to EVA you can treat her wounds, too. Now get to work.
I'm pretty sure you know this already, but if you don't have enough supplies for the both of you, your wounds come first.
Do you get my meaning, Snake?
You've still got a mission to complete.
Yeah. I know what I have to do.
Like this.
Snake! Tu m'entends?
Para-Medic!? Tu tombes à pic. EVA est gravement blessée!
Et toi aussi!
Heureusement, ses organes sont intacts, enfin je l'espère...
Calme-toi, Snake.
Que je me calme...?
Vous allez vous en sortir si on vous donne le bon traitement d'urgence.
Mais tu es le seul à pouvoir l'administrer. Tu as compris? Alors calme-toi.
OK, d'accord...
Bon, commence par ouvrir le Visualiseur de survie et par traiter ta blessure. Tu as ce qu'il te faut?
Je commence à être un peu à court.
Ensuite, en commutant le Visualiseur de survie sur EVA, tu pourras aussi traiter ses blessures. Allez, au travail.
Tu le sais déjà probablement, mais le traitement de tes blessures est prioritaire.
Tu as compris mon message, Snake?
Tu as encore une mission à accomplir.
Ouais. Je sais ce que je dois faire.
Comme ça.
Snake, if you slip off of there, you won't be able to climb back up. If you want to go up, find a different route.
Snake, ici, si tu glisses, tu ne pourras plus remonter. Si tu veux monter, trouve un autre chemin.
Any food you catch will gradually spoil over time, even if you store it in your backpack.
Toute la nourriture que tu attraperas finira par pourrir, même si tu la stockes dans ton sac à dos.
Snake, you can't return to the west from there. Head to the northeast!
Snake, d'ici, tu ne pourras pas retourner à l'ouest. Dirige-toi vers le nord-est!
Snake, look at your feet!
There's a rope stretched along the ground...
That was a close call.
Yeah, thanks.
Snake, attention où tu marches!
Il y a une corde tendue au ras du sol...
Tu l'as échappé belle.
The traps are set up to go off whenever a rope is disturbed.
You might want to try cutting the ropes beforehand by shooting them from a distance.
Ces pièges sont déclenchés dès que l'on fait bouger une corde.
Tu ferais peut-être bien de couper ces cordes à distance en leur tirant dessus.
Use a First Person View attack to hit enemies from afar.
But be warned: if you don't take them out in one hit, your cover will be blown.
When attacking from afar, it's crucial that you hit a vital spot dead-on.
Utilise l'Observation à la première personne pour tirer sur tes ennemis de loin.
Mais attention: si tu ne réussis pas du premier coup, ils vont te repérer.
En attaquant de loin, il est crucial de viser et d'atteindre un point vital.
Oh, and butterflies, too.
Oh, et aussi des papillons.
There are frogs, too.
Il y a aussi des grenouilles.
Snake, I see you've managed to punch through the wall. That hole should be big enough to pass through.
There's no time to lose. Get out of there, quick!
Snake, je vois que tu as réussi à faire un trou dans le mur. Ce trou devrait être assez grand pour passer à travers.
Il n'y a pas de temps à perdre. Sors de là et vite!
You've made a hole in the wall. Hurry and use it to get out of there!
Tu as creusé un trou dans le mur. Déguerpis vite de là en empruntant ce trou!
When you hide in the bushes, your Camo Index will go up.
As long as you stay still, you should be able to avoid being seen by the enemy even at fairly close range.
Use the bushes to your advantage and stay hidden.
Si tu te caches dans les buissons, ton Indice de camouflage va augmenter.
Tant que tu restes immobile, l'ennemi ne devrait pas pouvoir te repérer, même s'il est assez proche de toi.
Utilise les buissons à ton avantage et reste caché.
To lure an enemy to you, deliberately make a noise, or throw food at him to get his attention.
Pour attirer un ennemi vers toi, fais du bruit ou jette-lui de la nourriture pour attirer son attention.
You've killed all the enemies. Now you can cross the suspension bridge without worrying about being spotted.
Sokolov is in the abandoned factory to the north. Find him right away.
Snake, if you fall from that cliff you're dead meat.
Climb up before you lose your grip strength. Whatever happens, don't let go.
Tu as tué tous tes ennemis. Tu peux traverser ce pont suspendu sans risquer de te faire repérer.
Sokolov est dans l'usine désaffectée, au nord. Trouve-le immédiatement.
Snake, si tu tombes de cette falaise, c'est la fin assurée.
Remonte avant que ta jauge de prise n'arrive à zéro. En tout cas, ne lâche pas prise.
Snake, that area appears to be rigged with quite a few traps.
The best way to avoid danger is to get some inside information.
Inside information?
Snake, on dirait que cette zone est truffée de pièges.
A qui vous le dites.
Le meilleur moyen de les éviter, c'est d'obtenir des informations directement des ennemis.
Des informations directement des ennemis?
Snake, look at that wall. It's got a hole in it. If you climb in, you may be able to escape the enemy's search.
If you get cornered, try hiding in there.
Snake, regarde ce mur. Il a un trou à l'intérieur. Si tu y grimpes, tu pourras peut-être échapper à l'ennemi.
Si l'ennemi t'entoure, essaie de te cacher à l'intérieur.
It looks like it's raining out there. Be aware that you burn up a lot more stamina than usual in the rain.
If you want to conserve stamina, then you should find some shelter. Is there any place that'll keep the rain off your head?
On dirait que dehors, il pleut. N'oublie pas que sous la pluie, tu utilises beaucoup plus d'endurance que d'habitude.
Si tu veux économiser ton endurance, trouve-toi un abri. Il n'y a pas un endroit où tu pourras t'abriter de la pluie?
And you won't make a sound when you walk.
Et tu ne feras pas de bruit en marchant.
Bon à savoir.
This is patrol. Requesting fire support. Over.
Understood, patrol. Commencing fire support. As per standard operating procedure, this frequency will no longer be used. Out.
Ici la patrouille. Nous demandons des renforts armés. Terminé.
Bien reçu, patrouille. Nous envoyons des renforts armés. Conformément aux procédures standard, cette fréquence ne sera plus utilisée. Terminé.
Snake, the area you're in now is inhabited by snakes, birds, and other animals.
You should also be able to find wild mushrooms, fruits, and vegetables.
Snake, des serpents, des oiseaux et d'autres animaux vivent dans cette jungle.
Tu devrais aussi y trouver des fruits, des légumes et des champignons sauvages.
You'll also see frogs and butterflies... and the occasional crocodile.
Tu vas aussi tomber sur des grenouilles et des papillons... et parfois des crocodiles.
Crocodiles. They're called Indian Gavials. They're extremely vicious, so don't get too close.
Oui, ce sont des gavials. Ils sont particulièrement dangereux, alors ne t'approche pas trop d'eux.
This is Snake. Major Zero?
I read you, Snake.
I was ambushed by The Boss.
You were what!?
The drone's been shot to hell. It's up in flames.
That's not good. Enemy scouts are going to come looking for you.
Yeah, I know. But what was The Boss doing here in the first place? There's got to be a leak somewhere.
No, that's impossible. The man The Boss is working with, Volgin, isn't exactly on speaking terms with Khrushchev.
I lost my gun...The Boss destroyed it...
Snake, I know how you're feeling.
It's hard for me to believe, too - that a legendary hero like The Boss would go over to the Russians,
that she'd double-cross us like this... But that's how it is, and if you don't accept it, you'll never be able to beat her.
That's not the problem. In terms of sheer technique, I'll never be able to beat her. I know that all too well.
You've got to do it, Snake. She's your enemy and your objective.
Enemy! We were together for 10 years. And now you tell me she's my enemy?
Enough. Hurry to the factory where ADAM is waiting. Scouts have probably already been sent out to investigate the explosion.
You've lost your weapon, right?
That means you've got no chance of winning in a battle situation. Whatever you do, don't let them see you.
C'est Snake. Major Zero?
Je te reçois, Snake.
The Boss m'a tendu une embuscade.
Le drone a été complètement détruit. Parti en fumée.
Ca ne présage rien de bon. Des éclaireurs ennemis vont venir te chercher.
Ouais, je le sais. Mais qu'est-ce que The Boss faisait là? Il y a dû avoir une fuite d'informations.
C'est impossible. L'homme avec qui The Boss travaille, Volgin, n'est pas en très bon termes avec Khrouchtchev
J'ai perdu mon arme... The Boss l'a détruite...
Snake, je sais ce que tu ressens.
Pour moi aussi, c'est dur de le croire. Un héros légendaire comme The Boss soit
passé du côté ennemi. Mais c'est comme ça, et si tu ne l'acceptes pas, tu n'arriveras jamais à la battre.
Ce n'est pas ça, le problème. Pour ce qui est de la technique pure, je n'arriverai jamais à la battre. Je le sais parfaitement.
Il faut que tu essaies, Snake. C'est elle ton ennemi et ton objectif.
Mon ennemi! Mais nous avons été ensemble pendant 10 ans. Et maintenant, vous me dites que c'est elle mon ennemi?
Ca suffit. Dépêche-toi d'aller à l'usine où ADAM t'attend. Ils ont probablement déjà envoyé des éclaireurs pour enquêter sur cette explosion.
Tu as perdu ton arme, non?
Dans une bataille, tu n'auras aucune chance de survie. Quoi que tu fasses, ne les laisse pas te repérer.
On the same screen,
move the left analog stick while pressing the Weapon Window Button to move the icon for weapons that are already on your person.
Line up the weapon icon with the lower right and press the Enter Button to put that weapon into your backpack.
Dans le même écran,
déplace le joystick analogique gauche tout en appuyant sur la touche Fenêtre Armes pour déplacer les icônes des armes que tu portes déjà sur toi.
Aligne l'icône arme avec la position en bas à droite et appuie sur la touche Entrée pour mettre cette arme dans ton sac à dos.
Snake, what's wrong? Did something happen?
Yeah. It looks like they mistook me for a scientist trying to escape.
And so they took you "back" into the lab.
Well, anyway, you've succeeded in infiltrating the lab.
In that disguise, you should be able to move around the lab without arousing suspicion.
Snake, qu'est-ce qui ne va pas? Qu'est-ce qui t'est arrivé?
Oui. On dirait qu'ils m'ont pris pour un scientifique qui essayait de s'échapper.
Et alors ils t'ont "ramené" au laboratoire.
Bon, de toute façon, tu as réussi à t'infiltrer dans le labo.
Avec ce déguisement, tu devrais te déplacer dans le labo sans éveiller les soupçons.
Snake, once you head further north you'll be entering enemy territory.
You'd best get used to using camouflage and hunting for food while you have the convenience.
Snake, si tu te diriges plus au nord, tu vas entrer en territoire ennemi.
Tu ferais bien de te familiariser avec le camouflage et les techniques de chasse pendant que tu as encore le temps.
Look closely at the ceiling on the west side. See the sprinklers? If you shoot them, they'll start spraying water.
You can use the water to put the flames out if you catch on fire.
It should also lower the temperature of the room, so you'll lose less stamina as well. Try it out!
Regarde bien le plafond, côté ouest. Tu vois ces extincteurs automatiques? Si tu tires dessus, ils vont vaporiser de l'eau.
Tu pourras utiliser cette technique pour éteindre les flammes si tu es en feu.
Ça devrait aussi faire diminuer la température de la pièce, comme ça, tu perdras moins d'endurance. Alors essaie!
Sokolov is somewhere inside that lab. Disguise yourself as a scientist and go find him.
Sokolov est quelque part à l'intérieur du labo. Habille-toi en scientifique et va le chercher.
Snake! C'mon, say something! Snake! SNAKE!!
Snake! Enfin, dis quelque chose!
Snake, are you all right? That was a close call!
What the hell happened to me?
You were halfway drowned at the bottom of the river. Almost crossed over to the other side...
Other side... so that really was...
Something on your mind, Snake?
Major, was there a man in the Cobra unit called The Sorrow?
Yes, I've heard of him. He was an uncanny soldier who fought alongside The Boss.
What kind of man was he?
The Sorrow was a man with, well... special powers.
He had ESP, which was the subject of ex- tensive research in the Soviet Union at the time. He was especially gifted as a medium.
A medium?
Someone who can communicate with the spirit world, and evoke the spirits of the dead.
In other words, he could talk to ghosts. They say he could find out what was going on in a battle by talking to dead soldiers.
...What about him and The Boss...what was the story between them?
I don't know the details...why don't we ask Sigint?
Yo. I finished checking up on this Sorrow guy a while ago. Thought you guys already knew, though.
Knew what?
That he's dead. He's been dead for two years now.
He died two years ago...?
At Tselinoyarsk...you know, those cliffs you were at.
And The Boss is the one who did him in.
Yup. Two years ago, The Boss was sent by the CIA on a secret mission to Tselinoyarsk.
That's when she met The Sorrow, who'd gone back to the Soviet Union after the Cobras broke up at the end of the war.
Except this time they were enemies.
...And then what?
The Boss killed The Sorrow herself and accomplished her mission. At least, that's what the records say.
...So he was never there in the first place... he just couldn't let go of The Boss...
Yeah, I'm fine. It looks like it's not time for me to die yet.
I sure hope not. Otherwise the whole mission is shot. We're counting on you, pal.
Snake, ça va? Tu l'as échappé belle!
Mais qu'est-ce qui m'est arrivé?
Tu t'es presque noyé au fond de la rivière. Tu as failli passer dans l'autre monde.
L'autre monde... c'était donc ça...
A quoi tu penses, Snake?
Major, est-ce qu'il y a un des Cobras qui s'appelait The Sorrow?
J'ai entendu parler de lui. Un soldat mystérieux qui se battait aux côtés de The Boss.
A quoi ressemblait-il?
The Sorrow était un homme... aux pouvoirs spéciaux.
Des dons de perception extrasensorielle, très étudiés à l'époque par l'Union Soviétique. The Sorrow était particulièrement doué comme médium.

Primero, abre el Visualizador de Supervivencia pulsando el botón START.

o un tratamiento quirúrjico seleccionando el Botón de la Ventana de Arma.
Tienes roto el codo izquierdo y una costilla y desgarros en tu antebrazo, codo derecho y abdomen.
Para curarte, necesitas una intervención quirúrjica.
Mueve el cursor curativo con el joystick analógico izquierdo hacia la parte de tu cuerpo que necesite tratamiento.
Cuando hayas seleccionado la zona afectada,
mantén pulsado el Botón de la Ventana de Arma y utiliza el joystick analógico derecho para seleccionar el objeto médico y pulsa el botón Enter.
Gracias a este método, podrás recuperarte mejor utilizando ciertos objetos.
Para tratar la fractura de un hueso, primero tendrás que atablillar la zona a tratar y luego cubrirla con vendas. Eso será suficiente.
Para tratar desgarros, necesitarás desifectante para curar la herida, el kit de suturas para coserla,
antisépticos para cortar la hemorragia y vendas para cubrir la herida.
Si haces todo lo que he dicho, la herida se curará completamente.

La opción "UNIFORME" te permite seleccionar tu uniforme y con la opción "CARA", podrás cambiar la pintura de tu cara.
